# n2k library

This directory contains some of the files from
<https://github.com/kmsmith137/n2k> written by Kendrick Smith
<kmsmith@perimeterinstitute.ca>.

Files not used in Kotekan (tests, Python bindings etc.) have been
removed.

Some of the kernels have been updated to support ring-buffer
semantics.

This directory has the same layout as the upstream repository. To
update this directory, copy the respective files from the upstream
repository.
